subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four guard assertions pass, should these ten verified privileged Action revisions land together?
rationale: The revisions execute with repository tokens, scanning permissions, publishing credentials, release access, and agent capabilities, so grouped supply-chain acceptance requires human ownership.

options.title: Approve grouped rollup
options.body: Land all verified revisions together after the mechanical guard repair and exact-head validation.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker revisions for narrower acceptance and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped rollup
recommendation.body: Land all verified revisions together after the mechanical guard repair and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history provides the broadest individual routing signal across central CI and its immutable-pin guard contracts.
